body.input: Which robotics companies opened an office in the Netherlands in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information, the following robotics-related companies opened an office or new headquarters in the Netherlands in 2026:

1. **Robin Radar Systems** — Officially opened a new 9,000 sqm headquarters in **Delft**, with the opening attended by King Willem-Alexander. The expansion supports the company's growing counter-UAS (drone detection) radar business, with over 300 employees expected by end of 2026.

2. **Ledgnd** — Opened a new office in the Netherlands to meet growing demand, focusing on autonomous and semi-autosteering agricultural technology.

3. **Kite Robotics** — Involved in the opening of PwC's new Paris Proof office in Amsterdam, where their cleaning robots are deployed for sustainable facade maintenance.

Additionally, the **University of Twente** opened a new **Joint Robotics Lab** in Enschede on November 10, 2026, serving as a collaborative space for robotics research, education, and innovation — though this is a university research facility rather than a company office.

Note: EGT also opened an office in Den Bosch in May 2026, but EGT is a gaming/iGaming company rather than a robotics company.

explainability.content: Robin Radar Systems opened a new 9,000 sqm headquarters in Delft in 2026, as described in the expansion details of the company’s new facility.
Ledgnd announced the opening of a new office in the Netherlands in 2026, confirming its expansion into the Dutch market.
Kite Robotics participated in the opening of PwC’s new Paris Proof office in Amsterdam, indicating its involvement with a newly opened office in the Netherlands in 2026.
The University of Twente opened the Joint Robotics Lab in Enschede on 10 November 2026, providing a robotics research facility (not a company office).

context.content:
The expansion comes as drone warfare, hybrid threats and the civil use of unmanned air vehicles reshape defence and security priorities across Europe. With more than 300 employees expected by the end of 2026, the new headquarters strengthens Robin Radar’s ability to develop and deliver advanced radar systems at scale, while contributing to Europe’s sovereign defence industrial capacity. [...] The opening formed part of Robin Radar’s wider SIGNAL event, which also welcomed Derk Boswijk, the Netherlands’ Minister for Arms Procurement and Personnel, who visited the facility and delivered an address. The occasion highlighted the importance of technological innovation, industrial capacity and collaboration in strengthening Europe’s defence capabilities.

The new Delft headquarters significantly expands Robin Radar’s capacity for research, prototyping, specialised production, system integration and testing, alongside a fourfold increase in customer service and support capacity. Working with trusted Dutch manufacturing partners, the facility will support increased production and faster innovation cycles as demand for counter-UAS technology accelerates. # Official opening Joint Robotics Lab

Tuesday 10 November 2026 14:00 - 18:00

We’re excited to officially open the new Joint Robotics Lab of the Robotics Centre on November 10th, 2026!

In 2023 we launched the Robotics Centre to connect robotics research across the University of Twente. Three years on, the community has a home of its own. In this lab, researchers, students and partners will work together on research, education and innovation. We designed the space for collaboration, experiments and new ideas. [...] Come and celebrate this milestone with us on 10 November 2026. We have prepared a programme with live demos and hands-on activities. The keynote will be delivered by Dr Chiara Gabellieri, who recently received a €1.5 million ERC Starting Grant for her project Flytopus. In this project she is developing a soft, flexible aerial robot that adapts to its environment. It can grasp objects and land, move and perch on a wide range of surfaces.

You will also have plenty of time to meet the people behind the robots.

We would love to see you there!

Date: Tuesday 10-11-2026  
Location:Horst, Westhorst 224
